handle.directives:
Include @coraza.conf-recommended
Include @crs-setup.conf.example
SecRule REQBODY_PROCESSOR "!@rx (?:URLENCODED|MULTIPART|XML|JSON)" "id:1899999000,phase:1,pass,t:none,nolog,noauditlog,ctl:requestBodyProcessor=RAW"
Include @owasp_crs/*.conf
SecRuleUpdateActionById 949110 "pass"
SecRuleUpdateActionById 949111 "pass"
SecRuleUpdateActionById 959100 "pass"
SecRuleUpdateActionById 959101 "pass"
SecRuleEngine On
SecAuditEngine RelevantOnly
SecAuditLog /logs/waf-audit.log
SecAuditLogFormat JSON
SecAuditLogParts ABFHZ
SecResponseBodyAccess Off
SecRequestBodyLimit 1048576
SecRequestBodyInMemoryLimit 1024
# Argus Sentinel v4 — DETECT ONLY (sidecar default threshold)
#
# Paste each rule as a SINGLE line into the WAF custom directives box (global
# settings or a proxy host). The Ingressi builder drops continuation
# backslashes, Include and SecRequestBodyAccess, so nothing here may wrap.
#
#   * rule 1899999100 runs the ML check in phase 2 (CRS must be enabled: it
#     provides body access and the processors);
#   * rule 1899999101 records detections; CRS keeps blocking on its own —
#     switch to "deny,status:403" (see block.conf) once live scores have been
#     reviewed;
#   * rule 1899999102 records sidecar failures (fail-open is automatic).
#
# About the audit log: with the CRS loaded, @coraza.conf-recommended sets
# SecAuditLogRelevantStatus to 4xx/5xx only, so a detect hit on a request
# that keeps flowing (status 200) would NOT reach the audit log even though
# the rule carries "auditlog". `ctl:auditEngine=On` (accepted by the Ingressi
# filter; it only forces logging, never disables protection) makes the
# flagged transaction auditable — this is what puts ML detections into
# Security events. Verified against the built image.
#
# The error rule intentionally has NO ctl:auditEngine=On: a dead sidecar
# would otherwise emit one audit event per request. Its signal lives in the
# Caddy logs and in the mlcheck metrics summary; add ctl:auditEngine=On to it
# only if you deliberately accept that flood risk.
#
# Rollout order: plugin binary + sidecar FIRST (docker compose pull/build +
# up -d), then these rules. A node without the plugin refuses the whole
# config when it sees "mlcheck".
#
# Recommended id range: 1899999100-1899999199 (above the RAW body rule
# 1899999000, below the exclusion records' 1900000000). Do not reuse ids
# already taken by other custom rules.

SecAction "id:1899999100,phase:2,pass,nolog,noauditlog,mlcheck"
SecRule TX:argus_is_clean "@streq 0" "id:1899999101,phase:2,pass,log,auditlog,ctl:auditEngine=On,severity:WARNING,msg:'Argus v4 detected',tag:'argus-sentinel/v4',logdata:'attack_prob=%{tx.argus_risk_score}'"
SecRule TX:argus_error "@rx .+" "id:1899999102,phase:2,pass,log,auditlog,severity:WARNING,msg:'Argus v4 unavailable',tag:'argus-sentinel/error',logdata:'reason=%{tx.argus_error}'"
